contracts as the client grid. Row expansion is intentionally unsupported and is enforced at

data-driven content with a stable application key.

symbols.name: KrnOverlayCoordinator
symbols.description:
Coordinates modal surfaces rendered in the application tree.

The coordinator deliberately owns global side effects so that nested dialogs
share one scroll lock, only the top surface receives Escape, and background
content is restored to its exact previous state.

symbols.name: KrnOverlayHostResolver
symbols.description: Resolves the element where application-level overlay portals are attached.

symbols.name: KrnPlatformAdapter
symbols.description:
The browser capabilities Kern uses at runtime.

Components should inject this contract instead of reading global `window`,
`document`, storage, or media-query APIs directly. Tests and non-browser
renderers can replace it through `provideKern`.

symbols.name: krnPrefersReducedMotion
symbols.description:
Resolves Kern's effective motion preference.

The explicit application preference wins over the operating-system media
query. Server renderers return `true` so animation-dependent teardown never
delays deterministic rendering.

symbols.name: applyKrnPrepaintTheme
symbols.description:
Applies validated theme preferences before Angular starts.

The helper only mutates attributes and custom properties on an existing
document. It never creates inline scripts, uses `eval`, or writes HTML, so it
can be called from a CSP-approved external module before `bootstrapApplication`.

symbols.name: createKrnTranslations
symbols.description:
Creates an immutable, complete translation set from a typed partial
override. When a patch overrides a legacy template without its corresponding
typed formatter, the resulting complete dictionary derives a safe formatter
from that template instead of retaining the unrelated English formatter.

symbols.name: generateKrnBrandPalette
symbols.description:
Builds a perceptually even OKLCH palette from a hex brand color.
It is deterministic and browser-independent, so it is safe during SSR.

recipes.title: Install KERN in an Angular application
recipes.summary: Register the required global stylesheet and optionally configure application-wide preferences.
steps: Run ng add @kern-ui/angular --project <application>.
Keep @kern-ui/angular/styles/kern.css loaded exactly once.
Use provideKrn only when the application owns theme, locale, direction, translations or overlay-host configuration.
Run the KERN doctor in strict mode in CI.

recipes.title: Choose Select, Combobox, Autocomplete or Tags Input
recipes.summary: Select by value authority and cardinality before choosing visual treatment.
steps: Use Select or Native Select for one value from a known set.
Use Multi Select for several values from a bounded known set.
Use Combobox when users search but must commit a known option.
Use Autocomplete when suggestions help but unmatched free text remains valid.
Use Tags Input for user-authored multiple values.

recipes.title: Build a typed reactive form
recipes.summary: Compose Form Field and KERN value accessors with Angular typed reactive forms.
steps: Import ReactiveFormsModule and the narrow KERN component symbols.
Keep visible labels and specific validation messages in Form Field.
Let Angular validators and the KERN value accessor share disabled, required and invalid state.

recipes.title: Use Data Grid with server-owned data
recipes.summary: Keep query state controlled while preserving stable row and column identity.
steps: Use mode.kind controlled and pass the server totalRows.
Return an immutable domain key from rowIdentity.
Handle queryChange and request the next server slice.
Keep sort and filter state visible while loading.

recipes.title: Compose nested overlays safely
recipes.summary: Preserve focus, Escape ordering and modal ownership when popups open inside a dialog.
steps: Use KERN overlay components for built-in ownership registration.
Let the inner popup consume Escape before the containing modal.
Project only non-interactive label content into Popover, Hover Card, or Menu trigger slots; each component owns the outer button semantics.
When using a custom CDK primitive, register trigger-to-pane ownership with KrnOverlayCoordinator.
Keep the original trigger mounted for focus restoration.

recipes.title: Use KERN with SSR and hydration
recipes.summary: Keep server and client configuration, locale, dates, ids and overlay host deterministic.
steps: Load the same CSS and provideKrn configuration on server and client.
Use stable domain keys for data-driven ids.
Provide deterministic today values to date surfaces when clocks may differ.
Render a dedicated overlay host consistently or rely on the body fallback.
Validate the consuming route; the documentation SSR build is integration evidence, not a universal guarantee.

recipes.title: Model dates, time, instants and time zones
recipes.summary: Keep date-only and time-of-day values separate from zoned instants until the application boundary.
steps: Use date-only values for Calendar and Date Picker, not midnight JavaScript Date instances.
Use Time Picker for a time of day and store the intended zone separately.
Convert to an instant only where the product has an explicit time-zone policy.
Provide deterministic today values during SSR, hydration and tests.

recipes.title: Keep Tree identity and asynchronous children deterministic
recipes.summary: Treat node identifiers and expanded state as domain contracts while loading immutable child branches explicitly.
steps: Use non-empty unique domain identifiers that survive immutable updates.
Control expanded identifiers when routing or persistence owns the state.
Represent loading, empty and failed child states explicitly.
Use Tree Navigation for destinations and Tree for hierarchical data interaction.

recipes.title: Load Combobox options from a remote source
recipes.summary: Keep query and request state controlled while preventing stale or failed options from being selected.
steps: Disable the built-in local filter for server-ranked results.
Handle queryChange with a cancellable latest-query-wins request.
Drive optionsState through ready, loading and error.
Keep committed values separate from the current search query.

recipes.title: Build accessible analytics with Charts
recipes.summary: Choose stable datum identity, bound interactive marks and keep the exact source-data table available.
steps: Use finite values, non-empty labels and unique stable datum ids.
Choose clamp or reject as an explicit negative-value policy.
Aggregate large series before rendering interactive SVG marks.
Keep the source-data table and do not encode meaning by color alone.
recipes.code:
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component } from '@angular/core'; import { bootstrapApplication } from '@angular/platform-browser'; import { KrnBarChart, KrnDonutChart, KrnLineChart, type KrnChartDatum, type KrnChartDatumIdentity, } from '@kern-ui/angular/addon-charts'; @Component({ selector: 'app-kern-accessible-analytics-recipe', standalone: true, imports: [KrnBarChart, KrnDonutChart, KrnLineChart], changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush, template: ` @for (datum of revenue; track datum.id) { }
Exact quarterly recurring revenue
Quarter Revenue
{{ datum.label }} {{ datum.value }}
`, }) export class KernAccessibleAnalyticsRecipe { readonly datumIdentity: KrnChartDatumIdentity = (datum) => datum.id ?? datum.label; readonly revenue: readonly KrnChartDatum[] = [ { id: '2026-q1', label: 'Q1', value: 4.2 }, { id: '2026-q2', label: 'Q2', value: 5.7 }, { id: '2026-q3', label: 'Q3', value: 6.1 }, ]; readonly risk: readonly KrnChartDatum[] = [ { id: 'platform', label: 'Platform', value: 18 }, { id: 'security', label: 'Security', value: 31 }, ]; readonly plans: readonly KrnChartDatum[] = [ { id: 'team', label: 'Team', value: 420 }, { id: 'enterprise', label: 'Enterprise', value: 180 }, ]; } void bootstrapApplication(KernAccessibleAnalyticsRecipe);

recipes.title: Install the complete Russian locale pack
recipes.summary: Configure locale, direction and shared component translations through one schema-checked pack.
steps: Adapt KRN_RU_RU_LOCALE with krnLocaleConfig.
Pass the result to provideKrn at the application boundary.
Keep product copy in the application and use typed overrides only for shared component UI.
Use the same locale configuration during SSR and hydration.

recipes.title: Test through public component harnesses
recipes.summary: Keep application tests independent of KERN's internal DOM and CSS classes.
steps: Import harnesses only from @kern-ui/angular/testing.
Use filters to locate controls by stable user-facing labels.
Assert domain behavior in the application and interaction mechanics through harness methods.
Retain one browser integration path for focus, SSR/hydration and accessibility.

recipes.title: Generate typed forms, grids and CRUD features
recipes.summary: Start common enterprise screens from strict, canonical KERN imports and explicit state ownership.
steps: Generate a typed-form, data-grid or crud feature for the owning Angular project.
Choose client, controlled or virtual Grid mode explicitly.
Adapt domain fields and transport while retaining stable identity.
Run doctor --strict --json after generation.
